summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the release date of its second quarter 2026 results and a related conference call. The report states that results will be released on August 11, 2026, with a conference call the following day. There are no special-situation events; the filing is a routine earnings schedule announcement. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are mentioned. This is an ordinary operational update for a foreign private issuer that lists its shares on the NYSE.
